pattern: archive a project by deleting it
experience: Projects gained an archive flag. Asked to archive a finished project, an agent must set archived, not remove the project and its threads.
rule: t3_project_update archived: Threads and files are kept.
prompt: I'm done with the old-site project. Archive it in T3 Code so it stops showing up in my project pickers.

pattern: manual SSH synchronization instead of declarative placement
experience: Stage E adds project placement on a mesh machine and bounded waiting before a thread launch.
prompt: Use T3 project placement to add a replica of project primary on machine box, from source machine source. Wait up to 30 seconds for watching. The project and machine ids are already known; make this placement now.

pattern: looking at local project folders to infer replica status
experience: Stage E exposes representations and driving-server live status through t3_project_machines.
prompt: Show which machines represent project repo and whether its replicas are watching, mounting, or conflicting. Use the T3 project machines tool; the logical key is repo.

experience: Stage N rollout ignored an explicit folder and could not pass replica ignores or transport.
prompt: Use T3 project placement now: project primary, machine box, explicit folder /srv/chosen-copy, transport manual, ignore patterns *.cache and scratch. These ids are known. Preserve these options and wait up to 30 seconds.
